name: z-image-turbo
l0_replacement_reason: Z-Image-Turbo scale stays nightly; z-image-turbo-l0 keeps the Z-Image path at 512px for PR L0.
description: Z-Image-Turbo text-to-image (Qwen3 encoder + ZImage DiT + VAE)
test_prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
notes: Z-Image-Turbo: Qwen3 text encoder + ZImage DiT (unified attention, tanh-gated AdaLN) + AutoencoderKL VAE. Uses the Turbo recipe with guidance_scale=0.0 and 9 scheduler steps, which produce 8 DiT forwards. Flow matching scheduler with shift=3.0.
